parents.course: Seminar in Organizational Behavior and Theory

ns2:section.sectionText: This course will meet in 3015/3017 BIF. This is a doctoral seminar in organization theory. The purpose of the class is to familiarize aspiring researchers with the major bodies of thought in the field. The course covers both classic and contemporary research. It is intended to help you develop a schema for understanding organizations and organization-environment relations. The course is appropriate for PhD students in organizational behavior and other related fields of study.
